patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:SF Pro Text|SF Pro|SF Compact|SF Compact Text|SF Compact Rounded|SF Pro Rounded|SF Mono|Montserrat|Montserrat Static|Montserrat Arabic|IBM Plex Sans Arabic|Thmanyah Sans|Thmanyah Serif Display|Thmanyah Serif Text))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: SF Pro Text, SF Pro, SF Compact, SF Compact Text, SF Compact Rounded, SF Pro Rounded, SF Mono, Montserrat, Montserrat Static, Montserrat Arabic, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Thmanyah Sans, Thmanyah Serif Display, Thmanyah Serif Text.
<ActionSheet> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, actions, cancelLabel, onCancel, width, style.
<ActivityIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, color, style.
<ActivityView> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, thumbnail, people, apps, actions, onClose, width, style.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, actions, layout, fields, width, style.
<Alert> layout must be one of 'stacked' | 'side-by-side'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: count, dot, max, color, style.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, size, variant, destructive, disabled, fullWidth, leading, trailing, onClick, style.
<Button> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'glass'.
<Button> variant must be one of 'prominent' | 'tinted' | 'secondary' | 'borderless' | 'glass' | 'glass-tinted'.
<DatePicker> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: month, days, startWeekday, selected, today, onSelect, style.
<DeviceFrame> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: device, scale, children, style.
<DeviceFrame> device must be one of 'iphone' | 'iphone-max' | 'ipad'.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, symbol, title, description, action, style.
<EmptyState> variant must be one of 'title-subtitle' | 'large-symbol' | 'symbol-in-circle'.
<HomeIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: mode, style.
<HomeIndicator> mode must be one of 'light' | 'dark'.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, glyph, size, weight, color, fallback, style.
<Icon> weight must be one of 'regular' | 'medium' | 'semibold' | 'bold'.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, size, variant, destructive, disabled, label, onClick, style.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'glass'.
<IconButton> variant must be one of 'prominent' | 'tinted' | 'secondary' | 'borderless' | 'glass' | 'glass-tinted'.
<List> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: appearance, header, footer, children, style.
<List> appearance must be one of 'plain' | 'inset' | 'grouped'.
<ListFooter> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, style.
<ListRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, value, leading, image, accessory, trailing, height, destructive, disabled, separator, selected, onClick, style.
<ListRow> accessory must be one of 'none' | 'disclosure' | 'checkmark'.
<ListRow> height must be one of 'regular' | 'tall'.
<ListSectionHeader> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, trailing, uppercase, style.
<Material> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: material, radius, shadow, children.
<Material> material must be one of 'ultrathin' | 'thin' | 'regular' | 'thick' | 'chrome' | 'glass' | 'glass-medium' | 'glass-large' | 'glass-tinted'.
<Menu> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, width, style.
<NavigationBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, variant, leading, trailing.

<Notification> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: app, icon, title, body, time, expanded, media, stackCount, style.
<PageControl> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: count, selected, onChange, style.
<PickerWheel> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: options, selected, columns, onChange, style.
<Popover> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: arrow, width, children, style.
<Popover> arrow must be one of 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'.
<PopUpButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, disabled, onClick, style.
<ProgressBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, size, style.
<ProgressBar> size must be one of 'regular' | 'small'.
<Scrim> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, onClick, children, style.
<Scrim> variant must be one of 'default' | 'alert' | 'activity'.
<SearchField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, placeholder, state, onChange, onFocus, style.
<SearchField> state must be one of 'placeholder' | 'focused' | 'typing' | 'value'.
<SegmentedControl> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: segments, selected, disabled, onChange, style.
<Separator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, inset, vertical, style.

<Sheet> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: grabber, platform, detent, children, style.

<Sidebar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, width, footer, children, style.
<SidebarRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, image, selected, indent, badge, onClick, style.
<Slider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, min, max, ticks, leading, trailing, disabled, onChange, style.
<StatusBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: time, mode, style.

<Stepper> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, min, max, step, disabled, onChange, style.
<SwipeActions> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: actions, side, height, style.

<SwipeActions> height must be one of 'small' | 'large'.
<TabBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tabs, selected, onChange, style.
<Text> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, weight, color, as, align, children, style.

<Toggle> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: on, disabled, showAXLabel, onChange, style.
<Toolbar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, glass, style.
